source_evidence: Independent review rejects duplicate kill_pos_inline as an original design claim. The original kill_specific contains signed bounds, whole six-dword element copies, count decrement and reverse traversal. src/spot.h now owns one private erase_at implementation used by the mapped public kill_pos and kill_specific; the separately emitted public identity remains intact, with no export or artificial address anchor. Fresh strict restoration passes all 12 historical claims. Both originally open bodies remain mismatches; partial similarity does not establish an allocator-only ceiling or acceptance.
